name: Camping 101: Tailoring

angles.text: As a tailor, you can make Faction Banners that lift camp morale and energize allies in the field.

faq.answer: At Shen'dar Village, promising tailors can seek instruction in field craft. Show enough skill in tailoring and you can learn to make a Faction Banner for a wilderness campsite.
Taleen Shimmerthread is a skilled tailor in Shen'dar Village. She teaches qualified crafters to make camping items, including banners that lift spirits at camp.
Shen'dar Village is where Taleen Shimmerthread lives. Tailors go there to learn how to use their cloth-working craft to make camping gear.

aliases: what does tailoring make for camp
faq.answer: Tailors can learn to make a Faction Banner for camp. Planting one gives those resting there an inspiring presence.
faq.q: What camping item can tailors learn to craft?

faq.answer: You need to show skill in tailoring before Taleen Shimmerthread in Shen'dar Village will teach you to make a Faction Banner for camp.
faq.q: What are the requirements to learn the camping banner?

faq.answer: Faction banners lift spirits and sustain morale on a campaign. Tailors stitch them as an energizing focal point for adventurers on grueling journeys.
faq.q: Why are faction banners valuable at camp?

sections.body: A campsite in the wild calls for more than warm clothes. A well-made banner can give a camp a shared purpose, so clothworkers are urged to carry their craft beyond garments and bags. With further instruction, bolts of woven fabric become a sign of unity and fortitude.
sections.title: The Weaver's Contribution to Camp

sections.body: In Shen'dar Village, Taleen Shimmerthread teaches camping crafts to tailors with enough skill. She shows them how to fashion a Faction Banner. Stitched with care and planted at camp, it rallies allies and helps keep their spirits up through the trials ahead.
sections.title: Instruction in Shen'dar Village

summary: At Shen'dar Village, tailors can learn to make a Faction Banner for wilderness camps. The banner lifts spirits and helps sustain morale.
